on Tuesday it priced a $1B managed commercial real estate CLO, with about $820M of investment-grade securities expected to be placed with institutional investors.
The transaction will provide the company with non-mark-to-market, non-recourse term financing.
The CLO has a 30-month reinvestment period and carries an interest rate of Term SOFR +1.43% before transaction costs.
The transaction is expected to close on or around Oct. 2.
Wells Fargo Securities, LLC is acting as sole structuring agent, co-lead manager, and joint bookrunner.
